question: Where is the United Nations Ocean Conference being held in 2025?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Nice**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Union Minister Jitendra Singh Leads Indian Delegation to UN Ocean Conference in France.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Dr. Jitendra Singh**, **Earth Sciences Minister**, left for **France** to attend an **International Meet on Oceans**.

 
 
• 
 
The **United Nations Ocean Conference (UNOC)** is being held in **Nice, France.**

 
 
• 
 
The event includes **leaders, scientists, policymakers**, and **civil society** discussing **sustainable ocean governance**.
